title: Teleporters (Easy Version)
description: Consider points on the number line 0, 1, ..., n. There is a teleporter on each point 1 to n. The cost to use teleporter at i is a[i] + i. You start at 0 with c coins. What is the maximum number of teleporters you can use?
input_format: The first line contains t test cases. Each test case consists of n and c, followed by array a.
output_format: For each test case output the maximum number of teleporters.
